provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 6230 DYER ST, EL PASO, TX, 79904

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: In the afterschool class, cots were numbered with no matching list that showed which child was napping on wich cot.      This was corrected during inspection when caregiver created a list matching each numbered cot to a child by name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass: Operation does not have a working thermometer available during inspection. Thermometer needs batteries.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: Operation does not have current liability insurance policy availabel for review. Insurance expired 05/09/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Operation completed but did not have documentation showing a fire drill was done in December 2025.    This was corrected at inspection when a caregiver documented a on an emergency practices form showing a fired drill was completed 12/18/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies: Operation does not have transportation emergency plan available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §746.5619)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: Operation did not have documentation available for review showing the consumer product safety commission website was checked since February 2024.    This was corrected at inspection when a caregiver reviewed the website and completed form 2885, dating it 4/24/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 Report with a run date of 01/17/2025 indicates that the operation did not report the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by the required date of 1/15/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System Tested: Operation has an electronic smoke alarm system that has not been inspected since 07/17/2023. A new fire inspection was due 07/17/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §746.5315)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: Operation does not have a current fire inspection.  Last inspection completed on 07/17/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: In review of records, three staff members do not have proof of training in Poison Prevention/Hazardous Material, food allergy or administering medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation did not have a form showing they have reviewed the consumer product recall website available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: In the infant room, two cubbies were not labeled with the infant names.    This was corrected at inspection when caregiver labeled each cubby with the infant's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Transportation vehicle (Cadillac SUV) did not have a fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Two cribs in the infant room were not labeled.    This was corrected at inspection when caregiver labeled each crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: The director does not have current transportation training available for review.  Certificate available is dated 11/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2023 Report with a run date of 01/16/2023 indicates that the operation did not report the number of employees who left employment in 2023 by the required date of 1/15/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Harsh, Abusive or Profane Language: While conducting interviews two people overheard a caregiver yelling at a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Harsh, Abusive or Profane Language: While conducting interviews two people overheard a caregiver yelling at a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During a DFPS investigation visit to the operation, the investigator observed some live and dead roaches. A photo  of a dead roach was obtained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: During a DFPS investigation visit to the operation, some children were observed watching YouTube without the caregiver monitoring the screen time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: A toddler was observed walking around while holding and drinking from a training/sippy cup.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation has a fire inspection that expired on 03/15/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Two children were laying on cots not assigned to them.    This was corrected at inspection when the caretaker repositioned the children, placing them on their assigned cots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: All of the caregiver's records that were reviewed were missing the required 24 hours of annual training. Director stated the staff had not yet completed the required training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: In the infant room, two children's botlles were not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: While the operation had multiple first aid kits in different rooms/areas, none of them were complete. There was a combination of missing items among the various first aid kits to include missing thermometers, adhesive tape, scissors and band aids.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not have fire drills posted or available for review. CCR was not able to verify when the most recent fire drill was conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Ten children's records were reviewed. Six of the ten children's records were incomplete; there was a combination of Health statements, admission dates and emergency care authorizations missing among these six records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There are two metal shelves that were not anchored to the wall or the ground in the outdoor play area for after-school aged children. These metal structures were not being utilized for storage but were empty. These metal structures could tip over if climbed on, posing a risk of harm to children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: In the infant room, one infant who is not yet ready for table food, did not have any written feeding instructions available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement: In the infant room, the cribs were positioned in a way that allowed for the children to reach into the crib of another.  This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver repositioned the cribs so the children could not reach and touch each other.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement (26 TAC §746.2403(4))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director and the one provider did not complete the transportation training by the initial compliance date of 10/31/22. A new compliance date of 11/21/22 was given to the operation to comply.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There were two providers that were present and who were caring for children that did not have a completed background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: Two providers have expired CPR/First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: No Asphalt or Concrete Under Climbing Equipment Unless Unitary Surfacing Covers Use Zone: The operation will need to remove a climbing structure that has been installed over asphalt.     -----------------------  A used washer and dryer will need to be removed from the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Asphalt or Concrete Under Climbing Equipment Unless Unitary Surfacing Covers Use Zone (26 TAC §746.4601(8))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director and a provider will need to complete a transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The operation has not validated the employee list since 2/4/21. The validation of employees at the operation must be completed every 3 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The operation does not have the emergency authorization information for children being transported in the daycare's transportation vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Maintained: The operation has not updated their liability insurance policy information via the daycare's online account.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Maintained (26 TAC §746.201(8))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The operation's fire extinguishers have expired service tags. The service tags expired on 1/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Licensed Operations Required Fees: The operation has not paid the required annual fee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensed Operations Required Fees (26 TAC §745.509)

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation's gas inspection has expired as of 7/23/21.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)
